valid_fixes: Restore ReadApiPermission SourceArn to use wildcard stage /*/ instead of /prod/
invalid_patches: Changing the ApiUrl output to reference the v1 stage
Adding a second stage named prod
optimal_diagnostic_path: Invoke a GET on the read API; receive 403 Forbidden; check API Gateway stage and Lambda permission SourceArn; observe stage is 'v1' but permission only grants execution for 'prod'; fix StageName to 'prod' and SourceArn to wildcard.
observability_check: All read API calls return HTTP 403; Lambda invocation logs absent
observable_symptom: All GET requests to /friends/{playerId} and /friends/isFriend/{playerId}/{friendId} return 403 Forbidden. Write operations via SQS proceed normally. The API stage exists but API Gateway cannot invoke the Lambda due to a permission mismatch.
root_cause: ReadApiStage deploys at stage name 'v1' but ReadApiPermission grants invoke permission only for stage 'prod' (SourceArn includes /prod/ literal instead of */). API Gateway cannot invoke the Lambda function for the deployed stage, returning 403.
